_comment: Zenodo deposition metadata (legacy REST format: PUT /api/deposit/depositions/<id> with this object as the body, or enter the fields in the web form). DOI placeholders 10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-<name> are replaced by tools/zenodo_release.py writeback.

metadata.title: ORCHID bibliography
metadata.description:
ORCHID bibliography, version 2026.10: every paper the ORCHID CALPHAD data project knows about, with Crossref bibliographic metadata, the role each paper plays in ORCHID, counts of the evidence ORCHID released from it, and typed relations. Part of the ORCHID data release v2026.10.

What

  • 9,569 works (7,813 with DOI; 1,756 without, with stable ids from first author, year and title): 1,426 read by ORCHID, 3,576 cited as the original source of extracted values, 1,888 assessments behind TDB files, 2,283 original evaluations behind assessed (handbook) diagrams, 2,806 discovery leads (Crossref higher-order assessment discovery, not read).
  • 60,237 typed edges with provenance: cites / used_in_assessment (3,793 each; from the citation printed for each extracted value), models_system_in_tdb (3,760), reassesses (1,537; citation + same exact system, never from dates), handbook_reproduces (2,466), cited_by_crossref (44,888; publisher-deposited reference lists, kept separate).
  • DOIs matched from printed references (handbook source lines, cited sources of values, TDB header citations) are checked against Crossref (first author, year, title, journal): 5,385 verified, 104 weak (kept, flagged), 23 without a Crossref record; 19 mismatched DOIs were dropped (works kept without DOI; listed in DOI_MISMATCHES.md).
  • Files: papers.jsonl/.csv/.parquet, edges.jsonl/.csv/.parquet, papers/<key>.json (one record per paper), systems/<SYS>.json and systems_index.json, BibTeX and CSL-JSON (Crossref metadata), papers.jsonld (schema.org ScholarlyArticle), SCHEMA.md, DOI_MISMATCHES.md, CITATION.cff.

How

Deterministic builder (tools/build_bibliography.py) over the ORCHID release files (literature values, ESPEI bundle, phase registry, assessed phase assemblages), the SGTE-corpus link tables and handbook source lines, and a cache of Crossref REST API responses (retrieved 2026-10-23). No model calls; no abstracts, full text or PDFs.

Limitations

  • Crossref metadata as deposited; doi_match grades DOIs matched from printed references (weak matches are kept and flagged; mismatches were dropped).
  • Open-access status only from the Crossref license field.
  • Discovery leads were not read; their inferred candidate systems are hypotheses.
  • Version 1, machine-extracted: evidence counts derive from machine-extracted values.

Licence

Crossref bibliographic metadata: CC0. ORCHID-derived fields (roles, evidence counts, relations, checks): CC BY 4.0.

How to cite

R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID bibliography (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-bibliography
